changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.8:

• 🎯 Ultra-Strict Wake Word Spotting: Wake activation is now strictly restricted to 5 explicit multi-word phrases: 'Hey Jarvis', 'Hello Jarvis', 'Hi Jarvis', 'Wake Jarvis', and 'Wake Up Jarvis'. Standalone single words ('Jarvis', 'Hey', etc.) and ambient room noise will NEVER activate JARVIS.

• 🛡️ Zero Automatic Activation: Eliminated all single-word token triggers, partial 1-word hallucination checks, and background notification spontaneous wakes.

• 📱 Background & Lockscreen Action Execution: Apps, flashlights, and media controls execute reliably from the background.

• ⚡ 0ms Hot-Standby & Continuous Hardware Mic: Instant hands-free conversation with zero mic indicator blinking.
